svg.title: Empirical TV-distance convergence
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Repeated categorical simulations show empirical TV converging toward population TV as sample size increases. The plotted object is generated from d_hat_TV=1/2 sum_k |p_hat_k-q_hat_k|. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Deterministic-seed Monte Carlo test. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
